note: Illustrated example scenes for the sign lessons. The street is AI-made (Gemini or Codex image generation) without any signs; the official sign drawing from static/signs is placed on the empty post. Where a plate is shown, 'with' names the main sign it is read with, as in the checked study note. These are illustrations, not test photographs.

hidden.note: Kept out of the lessons on 2026-10-21 at the owner's request until a realistic picture replaces them. The files stay in static/signs/scenes.

UC60.1.reason: Cars are parked along the kerb on the sign's side, exactly where the sign forbids parking.

C55.reason: A 60 limit in a narrow residential street with parked cars; in a Danish town 60 belongs on a wide arterial road.

E19.reason: The plate faces the viewer with the arrow pointing into house walls; no road goes left there. Smeared roof behind the plate.
